text:
Priya (AE): Heads-up — NorthBank wants a BYOK POC. Requirements: customer-imported KEK (wrapped), mandatory batch attestation (signed), 7-day rotation, and a hard SLA: key op impact <=50ms end-to-end. They prefer eu-central. Any immediate dealbreakers?

Miguel (Solutions Eng): Not a blocker but needs design choices. Is the 50ms budget client-to-HSM or client-to-our-api? Also: will they accept HSM vendor attestation certs or do they need a signed statement from us per import?

Priya (AE): They want it counted end-to-end (app -> our API -> HSM). Attestation: per-import signed statement + ability to request on-demand re-attestation for audits.

Lina (Sales-Eng): Pricing: do we charge for import ceremonies / attestations separately in Dedicated/Private? And if NorthBank wants HSM in their VPC, how does that affect billing?

Sam (SRE): Operationally: our HSM KMA latency is ~6-25ms in-region. Network + proxy adds ~10-40ms depending on AZ peering. eu-central is fine if we colocate proxies. To meet <=50ms we must colocate app, key-proxy, and HSM or use client-side DEK caching.

Vik (Security): Compliance: they require FIPS 140-3 Level 3 evidence and documented import key ceremony notes. They also want SIEM ingestion (CEF/JSON) for HSM audit records. Can we publish schema and a delivery method?

Miguel (Solutions Eng): We can push audit events via secure forwarder (syslog over TLS or HTTPS webhook) in Private and Dedicated with VPC peering. Schema: timestamp, event_type, key_alias, operation, actor, audit_blob. I'll attach a sample payload for the questionnaire.

Priya (AE): They also asked about split-KMS capability (multi-custodian import) and quorum unwrap for higher assurance. Is that supported?

Sam (SRE): We support split import using a key-wrapping envelope protocol. Customers can provide multiple wrapping parts. The HSM vendor (if Thales/CloudHSM) supports multi-part import or offline XOR-split, we just route wrapped blobs. Implementation caveat: live rotation automation gets more complex with split keys — need runbook.

Lina (Sales-Eng): Great. Can we offer a managed-ops add-on for the import ceremony (onsite or remote witness) for an extra fee? They might prefer an assisted ceremony.

Vik (Security): Add language: we never persist plaintext KEK. We store only wrapped blobs and HSM-resident key handles. All key material is zeroed after import. This must be explicit for the security questionnaire.

Miguel (Solutions Eng): Draft POC runbook bits (will flesh out):

```
1) Pre-POC: exchange wrapping public key, network peering, SIEM endpoint
2) Customer prepares wrapped KEK parts -> uploads to secure bucket
3) Redwood import job runs in maintenance window -> HSM import -> generate attestation.pdf (signed by HSM vendor cert)
4) Verification tests: sign/unwrap test vector, rotate DEK, verify client decrypt
5) Weekly rotation cron + canary: rotate -> run smoke tests -> promote or rollback
```

Miguel (Solutions Eng): Example API calls (pseudo):

```
PUT /v1/kms/import
{ "alias": "northbank-kek", "wrapped_blob": "base64...", "parts": ["p1","p2"] }
POST /v1/kms/attestation?alias=northbank-kek  # returns signed attestation
```

Sam (SRE): For rotation SLA: we can provide automated canary + rollback. Guaranteeing a 2-hour completion window in SOW is risky due to customer environment factors. Recommend SOW: "target rotation window: 2 hours under standard topology; detailed playbook and escalation steps provided."

Lina (Sales-Eng): Billing model suggestion: Dedicated/Private: base reserved capacity (includes baseline HSM ops) + BYOK/ceremony one-time fee + monthly managed-ops surcharge for weekly rotations and attestation generation. I'll draft numbers.

Vik (Security): Also need pen-test evidence and KAT (Known Answer Test) records for each rotation run. Add logs retention TTL options (30/90/365 days) per customer ask.

Priya (AE): NorthBank also asked about fail-open vs fail-closed behavior during rotation failures. They prefer automatic fail-closed but want a safety revert if canary fails. Thoughts?

Miguel (Solutions Eng): Recommend fail-closed by default for security, with an automated rollback route that can be triggered by failed smoke tests. We'll include an emergency manual override for ops with strict audit trail and multi-person approval.

Sam (SRE): I'll generate a latency micro-benchmark script (eu-central to HSM) and post numbers before the kickoff. Also will include topology diagrams (proxy colocations, AZ choices).

Vik (Security): I'll author the security questionnaire snippets: import ceremony language, non-persistence of KEK, attestation delivery, SIEM schema, retention windows, and change-control.

Lina (Sales-Eng): Actions: Lina -> quote + surcharge model; Miguel -> POC runbook + API examples; Sam -> latency test + topology drawings; Vik -> security text; Priya -> schedule kickoff. ops-bot, create task.

ops-bot: task created: sales/2798765432 -> BYOK-POC-Runbook, assignees: [Miguel, Sam, Vik, Lina], due: 4 business days

Priya (AE): Thanks team. I'll set kickoff for Tue 09:00 CET and invite NorthBank + their security lead.

Miguel (Solutions Eng): Will post first draft runbook here by EOD Monday.

Sam (SRE): 👍 running initial synthetic now.
